subject: Upfront commit alternatives and volume slabs - Stratus AI
summary: Thread discussing an alternative to fixed Starter/Growth/Enterprise commits: anchor + slab pricing, quarterly true-ups, capped overage and a low-risk pilot option. Internal alignment on concessions (one free burst month credit, 20% credit for forecast miss on year 1) to close the deal.
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@stratusai.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Upfront commit alternatives and volume slabs - Stratus AI

Hi Oliver,

Following our call last week I wanted to send a concise set of options for an annual commit that gives you predictable unit economics while keeping forecast risk low. Attached are two artifacts: a short proposal (PDF) with three alternative structures, and a one-page usage forecast template you can fill out.

High-level options (very condensed):
- Anchor + Slabs: Small upfront anchor commit (low guaranteed token floor) + ascending volume slabs with per-token step discounts. Quarterly true-ups.
- Fixed Annual Commit: Traditional Starter/Growth/Enterprise bands with blended per-token pricing and standard overage rates.
- Pilot-first: 3-month paid pilot (reduced price) that converts into a pro-rated annual commit once we hit agreed thresholds.

As requested, I included an overage cap for the Anchor option (we propose a 35% cap on above-commit overage charges for yr1). Also added an option to convert unused commit into credits for the following quarter (limited). Please review the proposal and the forecast. If you can send a filled forecast by 5/28 we can model a price that aligns with your tolerance for forecast variance.

Next steps I suggest:
- You review and share the forecast with procurement (Procurement cc'd if helpful).
- We model two binding commercial options and one conservative pilot path.
- Finalize by mid-June to meet your FY procurement window.

Attachments: redwood-upfront-commit-alternatives-v1.pdf, usage-forecast-template.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on another quick call to walk through the spreadsheets.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0191

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@stratusai.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@stratusai.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upfront commit alternatives and volume slabs - Stratus AI

Tessa —

Thanks for the crisp options and the forecast template. A couple of immediate flags from procurement/finance:
- Forecast uncertainty: our usage is seasonal and tied to a feature launch in Q3. We cannot commit to large guarantees without protection.
- Price protection: we want a floor on price movement for 18-24 months (i.e., if market list prices go up we want protection).
- Burst behavior: during launch windows we can spike far beyond the slab; need a reasonable overage cap or a predictable burst bucket.

On the pilot option: procurement is open to a paid pilot but will expect partial credit against any converted annual commit.

Can you share a sample modeled schedule for the Anchor + Slabs option showing blended ASPs at 3 forecast profiles (conservative, expected, aggressive)? Also we need SOC2 + data handling language in the agreement before legal will approve.

If you can get me a modeled schedule and a term-sheet that includes an 18-month price protection clause, we can take it internal this week.

Oliver
VP Product, Stratus AI
oliver@stratusai.com

Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Upfront commit alternatives and volume slabs - Stratus AI

Team —

I modeled three scenarios and attached an updated proposal (redwood-upfront-commit-alternatives-v2.pdf) with concrete numbers. Summary of concession levers we can offer to close this:

1) Anchor + Slabs (our preferred default)
   - Anchor: 25M tokens guaranteed at $0.0028/token (credit applied monthly).
   - Slabs: next 75M tokens at $0.0022/token; 75M-250M at $0.0018/token; 250M+ at $0.0014/token.
   - Quarterly true-ups: reconcile committed vs actual, with credits applied to next quarter.
   - Overage cap: year 1 capped at 40% of overage charges (we absorb the rest once spike verified).
   - Forecast miss protection: if Stratus misses its yr1 forecast by >20% we issue a one-time credit equal to 20% of net monthly charges (to reduce downside).

2) Pilot-first path
   - 3-month paid pilot at $0.0035/token up to 30M tokens; 50% of pilot charges credited if they convert to an annual commit within 60 days.

3) Fixed Annual Commit (for procurement simplicity)
   - Blended rate for the voted band; higher commitment leads to lower blended price.

Additional notes: we can include an 18-month price-protection clause (protecting them from list-price increases) but we cannot guarantee downward price movement if models materially improve and our cost structure drops — we can agree to negotiate a refresh at 12 months.

Attachments: redwood-upfront-commit-alternatives-v2.pdf

Next steps I recommend:
- Send the modeled schedule and the v2 term sheet to Oliver + procurement.
- Offer a single free ‘burst’ month credit (equivalent to 50M tokens) applied once in year 1 if there is a launch spike >2x monthly baseline; helps with their launch risk.

If you want, I’ll include a short clause set for SOC2/controls to hand to legal (Laura can own).

- Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Oliver —

Thanks for the quick review and for surfacing procurement constraints. Based on your ask and internal discussions, here is the commercial we can send for signature (attached docu sign link below):

- Structure: Anchor + Slabs (preferred) with Pilot conversion path.
- Anchor: 25M tokens @ $0.0028/token guaranteed.
- Volume Slabs: 25M-100M @ $0.0022, 100M-300M @ $0.0018, 300M+ @ $0.0014.
- Quarterly true-ups with crediting.
- Overage: capped at 40% of billed overage in year 1 (we absorb verified spikes above cap).
- Pilot: 3-month paid pilot (up to 30M tokens) at $0.0035/token; 50% of pilot fees credited if converted to annual commit within 60 days.
- Forecast protection: one-time usage credit equal to 20% of monthly net charges if yr1 actual < 80% of committed volume.
- Price protection: 18 months protection against list price increases; we will offer an optional review at 12 months if model/infra costs materially change.
- Compliance: SOC2 type II evidence and our data handling addendum attached (Laura will provide).

We are also including a one-off launch credit: one free burst month (50M token credit) that can be applied during year 1 for a verified product launch spike.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/STRAT-2026-0618
Attachments: redwood-upfront-commit-alternatives-v2.pdf, usage-forecast-template.xlsx

If this matches what you need we can route for signature and aim for an effective date of July 1 so we align with your FY. Happy to jump on a 20-minute handoff call with procurement to walk term language.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
